name: Pork skewers
summary: Grilled pork skewers, one of the valley’s favourite homestay plates. Guests eat them with mắc khén beside sticky rice and grilled fish.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s Mai Châu list. Báo Phú Thọ names thịt xiên with mắc khén in a homestay meal.
howToEat: At the homestay table, with the evening meal, with mắc khén.
seoTitle: Pork skewers in Mai Chau — thịt lợn xiên nướng
seoDescription: Thịt lợn xiên nướng is grilled pork skewers at the Mai Châu homestay, eaten with mắc khén beside sticky rice and grilled fish.
